about: Security defects planted in examples/online-shop/faulty by scripts/examples/plant_online_shop.py. scripts/check-security.mjs --expected scores the entries of "defects". kind: code = check-security.mjs is designed to find it; runtime = needs an interaction the checker does not perform; human = needs a person. Defects that no checker rule covers are listed in "not_scored" with rule null, because the --expected loader requires a rule string.

defects.summary: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline' so that a pasted inline tag can run; any injected inline script would run too.
defects.fixed_by: No inline script; script-src lists 'self' and the exact third-party origins used after consent.

defects.summary: script-src allows the whole https: scheme, which lets scripts load from any host.
The page sends neither CSP frame-ancestors nor X-Frame-Options, so another site can frame it (clickjacking).
defects.fixed_by: frame-ancestors 'none' in the CSP and X-Frame-Options: DENY.

defects.summary: The checkout page is sent without X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
The checkout form sends the delivery address and email over plain HTTP.
defects.fixed_by: The form posts to a same-origin address; the site is served over HTTPS only.

defects.summary: Referrer-Policy: unsafe-url sends the full address of the order confirmation to every site the page loads from or links to.
The page is sent without any Content-Security-Policy.
defects.fixed_by: Every HTML response carries the site's CSP.

defects.summary: The Server header discloses the web server and its version.
defects.fixed_by: No Server header with a version number.

defects.summary: A library is loaded from a public CDN without an integrity attribute: if the file changes, the page runs the new code.
defects.fixed_by: No library from a CDN; the site's own scripts are served from its origin.

defects.summary: A link to another site opens in a new tab without rel="noopener".
defects.fixed_by: The link opens in the same tab; a link that must open a new tab carries rel="noopener".
